entry_limitations: No cross-clock timestamp subtraction or precise callee pre-entry timer. CPU samples bracket entry at roughly 1 ms resolution and do not prove that every gap is JIT. TurboFan compile durations may be background work. Warm fresh-solver external calls remain 356 ms.
decision: Separate completed compilation/admission from evaluator service at the existing assertion step return. Also return when recovery requests another compilation. Preserve all audit checks, paired emission, parser and evaluator; no code-shape or accounting treatment.
followup: T3 first comparison exposed later stalls. The original saved profile attributes the tail to unbounded suffix searches in paired-default validation. Restrict searches to the current edge while preserving accepted positions/full graph comparison; return after each existing evaluator unit instead of fusing 32. No new profile run was required.

residual.interpretation: Inferred residual owner from the unchanged evaluator path, original mapped profile and persistence after caller batching/paired-scan repairs. The checkpoint follows the complete synchronous replay partition; no claim of a newly instrumented per-call T2 body timer.
residual.scope_disposition: Staging replay partition crosses into the shared partition proof owner and its replay/cap/identity/lifetime obligations. Not implemented in this first-policy assertion programme.
